content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

The popular [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/alternatives-gumroad-payhip-restricted-countries-explained-digital-creators|COREMERCH guide to alternatives]] to Stripe, such as Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle, offer varying degrees of functionality for Nigerian creators. Gumroad, for instance, allows creators to sell digital products, but its payment processing fees can be as high as 3.5%. Lemon Squeezy, on the other hand, offers a more affordable option with a 0.5% transaction fee, but its scalability and customizability are limited. Paddle, while offering a robust set of features, is not available in Nigeria, making it an unreliable choice.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The major platforms, including Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad, have imposed restrictions on creators in Nigeria and other countries. This means that creators are left with limited options for processing payments, and those who rely on these platforms are forced to navigate complex and costly workarounds. In contrast, sovereign commerce solutions, such as COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, are designed to bypass these restrictions and provide creators with a permanent structural alternative at the base layer.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The payment speed, fees, and real costs associated with each option vary widely. Gumroad's 3.5% transaction fee, for example, can add up quickly for creators who sell high-value digital products. In contrast, NOWPayments, a key component of COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee, making it a more cost-effective option for creators who want to avoid the high fees associated with traditional payment processors.
Nigerian creators can bypass Stripe's restrictions and sell digital products with a sovereign commerce solution.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The ownership, automation, and delivery features offered by each option also differ significantly. Gumroad, for instance, allows creators to maintain ownership of their digital products, but its automation features are limited, making it difficult to scale. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack provides creators with full ownership and control over their digital products, as well as automation features that allow for seamless delivery and customer management.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The most important question for Nigerian digital creators is: how can I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country? The answer is to choose a sovereign commerce solution, such as COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, which provides a permanent structural alternative at the base layer and bypasses the restrictions imposed by major platforms.
NOWPayments offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee, making it a more cost-effective option for creators.

You can also visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about our products and pricing.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.

Yes, sovereign commerce solutions can be integrated with existing stores, but it's recommended to deploy a new store with a sovereign commerce solution for maximum benefits.
